sn47.24:1.2: “Bhikkhus, there are these four kinds of mindfulness meditation.
sn47.24:1.4: It’s when a bhikkhu meditates by observing an aspect of the body—ardently aware and comprehending, without craving and aversion towards the world
sn47.24:1.5: They meditate observing an aspect of feelings …
sn47.24:1.7: principles—ardently aware and comprehending, without craving and aversion towards the world
sn47.24:1.8: These are the four kinds of mindfulness meditation.”
